```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  claude-code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up .NET Core
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Analyze code with SonarQube
        uses: SonarSource/sonarcloud-github-action@master
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_HOST_URL: https://sonarcloud.io
          SONAR_ORGANIZATION: your-organization
          SONAR_PROJECT_KEY: thomhurst_ModularPipelines
          SONAR_BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}

      - name: Run code analysis with Roslynator
        run: dotnet tool install --global roslynator-cli && roslynator analyze src

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

      - name: Check code style with StyleCop
        run: dotnet tool install --global stylecop.msbuild && stylecop /p:StyleCopSettingsFile=stylecop.json /p:ProjectName=ModularPipelines /p:OutputPath=./stylecop-results.xml

      - name: Upload code coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella
          fail_ci_if_error: true
```
